# Marni Blythe Speaks

> Marni Blythe is a keynote speaker and the creator of Human Intelligence
> (HI) in the Age of AI — a framework for leadership, communication, and
> culture skills that AI cannot replicate. She speaks to education,
> insurance, financial services, technology, corporate, and healthcare
> audiences at conferences, corporate retreats, and all-staff meetings.

## Signature Keynote
- [Human Intelligence in the Age of AI](https://marniblythespeaks.com/speaking): Marni's signature 45-60 minute keynote (also available as a half/full-day workshop, in-person, virtual, or hybrid) arguing that emotional intelligence, trust-building, and honest communication — not AI — are the highest-leverage skills in an organization.
